prompt_text: Best CRM for a 2 person fundraising team
response_text:
### Best CRM for a 2-Person Fundraising Team

For a small team of just 2 people focused on fundraising, prioritize CRMs that are **affordable (free tiers or low-cost plans under $100/month)**, **easy to set up and use** (minimal learning curve, intuitive interfaces), **all-in-one** (combining donor management, campaigns, emails, and tracking without needing add-ons), and **scalable** for growth. Avoid enterprise-level tools like Raiser's Edge NXT, which are overkill, expensive, and complex for tiny teams.

Based on 2026 reviews from sources like Double the Donation, G2, GoodUnited, and Virtuous, here are the **top 3 recommendations** tailored to your needs. I focused on tools praised for simplicity, speed, and small-team efficiency.

#### 1. **Givebutter** (Top Pick – Best Overall for Small Teams)
   - **Why it fits**: Free forever for core features (donor CRM, peer-to-peer fundraising, events, text/email campaigns, and automated engagement). Scales seamlessly as you grow. G2 and Double the Donation highlight its "fast campaign execution" and "modern, all-in-one" design – perfect for 2 people handling everything without IT support.
   - **Key Features**:
     | Feature | Details |
     |---------|---------|
     | Pricing | Free (2.95% + $0.30/transaction); premium add-ons from $19/mo |
     | Donor Management | Unlimited contacts, segmentation, giving history |
     | Fundraising Tools | Forms, auctions, crowdfunding, recurring donations |
     | Team Collaboration | Shared dashboard, real-time updates |
     | Integrations | Zapier, QuickBooks, 1,000+ apps |
   - **Pros**: No contracts, mobile app, built-in comms (email/SMS). Used by 20,000+ nonprofits.
   - **Cons**: Transaction fees on free plan (waived on paid).
   - **Start Here**: [Givebutter](https://givebutter.com) – Set up in minutes.

#### 2. **Bloomerang** (Best for Donor Retention Focus)
   - **Why it fits**: Starts at $99/mo (lite plan for small teams), with a simple interface for tracking donor relationships and engagement scores. Lark and G2 reviews call it ideal for "mid-sized nonprofits aiming to retain supporters" – but its ease makes it great for duos too.
   - **Key Features**:
     | Feature | Details |
     |---------|---------|
     | Pricing | $99/mo (up to 500 contacts); free trial |
     | Donor Management | Engagement scoring, wealth screening, automation |
     | Fundraising Tools | Online forms, events, reports |
     | Team Collaboration | Role-based access, task assignments |
     | Integrations | Mailchimp, QuickBooks |
   - **Pros**: Strong analytics for personalized outreach; unlimited users.
   - **Cons**: No free tier; slightly higher cost.
   - **Start Here**: [Bloomerang](https://bloomerang.co) – 30-day trial.

#### 3. **Neon CRM** (Best All-in-One Value)
   - **Why it fits**: Affordable from $99/mo, covers donor management, events, memberships, and grants in one platform. LiveImpact and StratusLive praise it for small orgs needing "basic volunteer tracking" without complexity.
   - **Key Features**:
     | Feature | Details |
     |---------|---------|
     | Pricing | $99/mo (lite); free demo |
     | Donor Management | Profiles, queries, automation |
     | Fundraising Tools | Pledges, auctions, peer-to-peer |
     | Team Collaboration | Custom dashboards, permissions |
     | Integrations | 100+ (PayPal, Eventbrite) |
   - **Pros**: Robust reporting; handles growth well.
   - **Cons**: Steeper initial setup than Givebutter.
   - **Start Here**: [Neon CRM](https://neonone.com) – Free demo.

#### Quick Comparison Table
| CRM        | Starting Price | Free Tier? | Ease of Use (G2 Rating) | Best For                  |
|------------|----------------|------------|--------------------------|---------------------------|
| **Givebutter** | Free          | Yes       | 4.9/5                   | Speed & zero-cost start  |
| **Bloomerang** | $99/mo       | Trial     | 4.7/5                   | Donor relationships      |
| **Neon CRM**   | $99/mo       | Demo      | 4.6/5                   | All-in-one operations    |

**Recommendation**: Start with **Givebutter** – it's free, handles 90% of a 2-person team's needs, and lets you test without risk. If you need advanced donor insights, upgrade to Bloomerang. All have free trials/demos; check your specific integrations (e.g., email tools) before committing. For more, see [Double the Donation's 2026 list](https://doublethedonation.com/top-nonprofit-crms/).
